messages:
julia: Quick flag  found inconsistency: embeddings examples show both `[{input: 'x'}]` and `{inputs: ['x']}` across docs. OpenAPI uses object (`inputs`) but several quickstarts still use array.

max: Which quickstarts? JS, curl, or python?

julia: JS quickstart + the tutorial snippet. Filed docs PR draft already.

patrick: Runtime expects `{"inputs": [...]}` now. We shipped that change last quarter. Docs should canonicalize on the object.

emily: I'll update the quickstarts and the OpenAPI example to the object shape and add a tiny migration snippet: `old -> new` mapping. Keep a legacy note for a release cycle.

docs-bot: PR #2499 created by emily (draft): update examples, add migration note under /docs/migrations/embeddings-array-to-object.md. Checklist: update JS/Python/curl snippets, update OpenAPI examples, run docs smoke tests.

max: Also found response example mismatch: some pages show `data: [{embedding: [...] }]` while runtime returns `{embeddings: [[...]], model: '..'}`. Please standardize to `embeddings` top-level array.

emily: noted. I'll replace `data`-style responses and add a short explanation: "Legacy responses used `data` array of objects; current API uses `embeddings` array."

julia: once merged can someone run the staging smoke tests? Want to ensure site build renders snippets correctly.

patrick: I'll run the staging runbook tests after deploy. If any old examples are left behind the linter should catch them.

emily: merging PR after one more review. ping when staging smoke tests pass.

docs-bot: PR #2499 merged to main. Site redeploy scheduled. Migration note added.
